fees.tuitionAnnual.locator: UG fee notification NITP/734/2024 (scanned, hand-read), Part B, 'Parent's income more than 5.00 Lakh' column. Mandatory = recurring 15,300/yr + one-time non-refundable (Dev 30,000, Admission 4,000, ID 200, T&P 2,000, Alumni 1,500, Convocation 3,000 = 40,700)/4 = 10,175. Hostel = hostel fee (multi-occupancy) 24,000 + maintenance 4,000 + mess advance 40,000; refundable caution/security excluded. Only circular on the fee page ('onwards' applies to 2026 batch by its wording)
